reel.useGuidance:

The acting area is the open cobbled floor around the battered stone defendant's podium and in front of the raised judicial bench platform where the judge sits.
- The podium is a chipped stone block with iron rings and a crimson banner, set on a low two-tier stone base near the centre of the square.
- The judicial platform rises behind and beside the podium. It is a tall structure of dark stone and timber with spiked posts and crimson emblem banners across its front, an iron railing and the bench on top, and stone staircases at both ends, the broader flight on the far side.
- A tall grey tower with arched windows and long crimson banners stands behind the platform.
- Across the square from the platform, an arched gateway with an iron portcullis is set in the grey crenellated walls, with crates stacked at its base.
- The near edge of the square is framed by pale sandstone building corners with a large crimson skull-emblem banner on an iron rod, and wooden barrels and iron-bound crates at their bases.
- The floor is worn pale cobblestone with grass in the joints.
- The plaza is lit by bright, clear sunlight under a blue sky, with crisp shadows.
- Above the rooftops, a colossal fortress with twin-spired towers, a soaring central arch and crimson banners dominates the skyline. It remains standing until a later shot explicitly calls for its destruction.

- The judicial platform turns toward a more frontal, cross-square view.

10.417 to 10.917 seconds: Completely still hold on the remaining side, approximately 270 degrees from the opening position. This position sits near the foot of the broad staircase and the banner tower. The camera looks across the podium toward the portcullis gate wall and the open passage, with the judicial platform at the near side of the frame. shots.title: The Court in the Plaza
shots.sourceExcerpt:
A judicial bench and battered defendant’s podium occupy a sunlit square. Three curious citizens stop to watch. Beyond the rooftops, an enormous black fortress dominates the skyline, its battlements bristling with crimson banners.

The guard places Riley behind the podium. She edges toward an open passage. Without looking up, he slides his chair into her path. She returns to the podium.
shots.description: Opening: a wide, slightly low frame from the plaza edge. The sunlit square has the judicial bench in the near foreground at one side and the tall stone podium on its stepped base at center. The enormous fortress with crimson-bannered battlements dominates the skyline beyond the rooftops. Three curious citizens stop at the edge of frame to watch. The guard walks Riley across the cobbles, steps her up onto the podium base and places her behind the podium on the bench-facing side. She is shorter than the podium. As she settles behind it, only a sliver of her shoulder and hair stays visible at its edge. The guard sits in a chair beside the podium. The camera holds the wide with a slow, slight push. Ending: a wide, still composition of the podium, which seems to have swallowed its defendant, with the seated guard beside it and the fortress looming above.
shots.atmosphere: Bright daylight, open square, faint wind moving the crimson banners, distant city murmur.
shots.music: Sparse, mock-solemn low brass, held back.

- The near sandstone corner with its emblem banner, barrels and crates slides out of frame.
- The podium swings round to show a new face.
- The portcullis gate and its stacked crates draw nearer along the wall.
- The judicial platform turns toward a more frontal, cross-square view.

The camera looks across the podium toward the portcullis gate wall and the open passage, with the judicial platform at the near side of the frame. 14.083 to 15.083 seconds: Completely still final hold near the opening shooting position, approximately 360 degrees from the start. The layout matches the opening view of <Picture 1>, with the same intact fortress, banners, podium, platform, gate and sunlight.
